description: After a CMS or catalogue save, apps/admin (lib/storefront-cache.ts) asks apps/web (app/api/revalidate) to drop the cached reads that save affected. This is the only HTTP call between the two apps. Written by the consumer; apps/web/testing/contracts verifies the provider against it. `{{secret}}` is STOREFRONT_REVALIDATE_SECRET, the same value in both apps. The body names the cache tags to expire (packages/cache/src/tags.ts) and the products whose covers to pre-build; a ping with no body (an older admin) expires everything.

interactions.name: a targeted cache ping naming what changed
a CMS-only cache ping that warms no covers
a bare cache ping from an older admin, expiring everything
a cache ping naming a tag outside the taxonomy
a cache ping with the wrong secret
